bio: Bio-Landhotel Moarwirt is an idyllic escape and on top of that they serve fantastic food! This lovely inn, so typical of the region, boasts a gorgeous interior with modern Alpine-style decor. In this setting, diners tuck into freshly prepared regional cuisine made using predominantly local organic produce. The potato dumplings are a must! The restaurant raises its own chickens and sheep and has a small vegetable and herb garden. In summer, the beer garden overlooking the Isar Valley is the place to be. If you want to stay a little longer, cosy guestrooms are available....
